decision.reason: [ev-f8aa0a8a4299] is a single changelog line saying "resource customization for CustomResourceDefinition" was added. It does not say what kind of customization this is (health check, actions, ignore differences or something else), which settings or fields it uses, or whether the default behaviour for existing CRD resources changes. Without that, the change, who is exposed and what happens if the operator does nothing can't be determined. The PR (#21416) or the docs for this feature would be needed.
